video_summary.overall_goal: Create and save a new recipe by filling in visible recipe fields in the baker's percentage calculator.
video_summary.description: The recording starts on an empty Baker's Percentage Calculator recipe list. The user opens the add-recipe form, enters a recipe name, edits ingredient and other recipe fields with the Android keyboard, saves the recipe, and returns to the list where a new recipe entry is visible.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app opens to the Baker's Percentage Calculator main screen in dark mode. The list is empty and a message prompts the user to press the plus button to add the first recipe.
steps.system_response: The empty recipe list remains visible.
steps.visual_feedback: No visible change occurs while the main screen is shown.
steps.intent_task: View the starting state before adding a recipe.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The empty recipe list is visible with the pink floating plus button near the lower-right corner.
steps.system_response: The app opens a recipe entry form.
steps.navigation_change: Recipe list changes to an add/edit recipe form.
steps.visual_feedback: The empty list is replaced by fields for recipe details.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A recipe form is visible with fields for Recipe Name, Unit, Ingredients, Notes, Oven Temp & Time, and a Save Recipe button. The default unit shows grams and the default ingredient name shows Flour.
steps.system_response: The Recipe Name field receives focus and the Android keyboard opens.
steps.visual_feedback: The text cursor appears in the Recipe Name field and the keyboard covers the lower part of the screen.
steps.intent_task: Prepare to enter the recipe name.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The recipe form remains open with the Recipe Name field focused and the Android keyboard visible.
steps.system_response: Text appears in the Recipe Name field.
steps.visual_feedback: The field shows short text that appears to read "cake"; the keyboard suggestion row updates while typing.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The recipe form is visible with the default Flour ingredient row. The ingredient amount field is selected and a numeric keyboard is visible.
visible_ui_elements: Recipe Name field with entered text
steps.system_response: The ingredient amount value changes in the amount field.
steps.visual_feedback: The amount field is highlighted and later shows a value that appears to read "50.0".
steps.intent_task: Set the amount for the Flour ingredient.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The recipe form remains open. The Notes field is visible above the Save Recipe button and the Android keyboard remains open.
steps.system_response: Text is entered into the Notes field.
steps.visual_feedback: The Notes field receives focus and contains short text, but the exact characters are obscured by motion and viewing angle.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Oven Temp & Time field is visible near the bottom of the form, with the Save Recipe button below it and the Android keyboard still open.
steps.system_response: Text is entered into the Oven Temp & Time field.
steps.visual_feedback: The Oven Temp & Time field is focused and appears to contain a short numeric value, but the exact value is unclear.
steps.intent_task: Record baking temperature or timing information.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The recipe form is still visible with the Save Recipe button above the Android keyboard.
steps.system_response: The app saves the recipe and returns to the main recipe list.
steps.navigation_change: Recipe form changes back to the recipe list.
steps.visual_feedback: The keyboard disappears and the form is replaced by the list screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Baker's Percentage Calculator main screen is visible again. A recipe entry appears in the list near the top, and the pink floating plus button remains at the lower-right corner.
steps.system_response: The saved recipe remains visible in the list.
steps.visual_feedback: A list item appears where the screen was previously empty.
steps.intent_task: Confirm that the recipe was saved.

overall_flow: The app starts on an empty recipe list.
The user taps the plus button to open a recipe form.
The user fills in the recipe name, ingredient amount, notes, and oven information.
The app returns to the recipe list with a new saved recipe entry visible.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on an empty recipe list with a message telling the user to press the plus button to add a recipe.
Step 2: The user taps the plus button to start adding a recipe.
Step 3: The recipe form opens and the user taps the recipe name field.
Step 4: The user types a short recipe name that appears to be cake.
Step 5: The user edits the Flour ingredient amount, which appears to become 50.0.
Step 6: The user enters short notes, but the exact text is unclear.
Step 7: The user enters oven temperature or time information, but the exact value is unclear.
Step 8: The user taps Save Recipe to save the form.
Step 9: The app returns to the main list and shows the new saved recipe.
